conviction_note: The Q3 headline lines were pre-released on 24 Sep and matched PAP consensus, so the release carries nothing new on them. What it does carry is the management statement on the 2026 forecast, which the QSr must contain. That forecast is stale: 9M EBITDA of 942m against a FY guide of 1,112m implies a Q4 17% below Q4 2025. The company raised its guide during Q3-report prep in 2021 and 2023, but did not do so in 2025, when it beat by 3%, and has filed no update by 23 Oct. Hence a small positive lean (p_up 53) on a pre-released-period scale (abs 3.0). The findings sum (+0.3) and the scaled number (+0.18) agree in sign and are of similar size.

findings.finding: The 2026 forecast the QSr must comment on is stale. 9M EBITDA of 942m (242+375+325) and 9M net of 567m (132+234+201) imply Q4 EBITDA of 170m and Q4 net of 69m to reach the 1,112m / 636m guide, against 205m / 93m in Q4 2025. The company's documented Q3-report practice includes re-verifying the annual forecast, and it raised the guide that way in Oct 2021 (+15.5% net) and Oct 2023 (+16% net). This year's gap (~+3-4% at a flat Q4) is smaller, the 2021/2023 updates came as separate ESPIs days before the report, and none has come by 23 Oct, so a raise is possible but not the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In 2025 the company beat its guide by 3% without updating it. The Oct 2021 and Oct 2023 raises are documented, but their price reactions were not measured here. The FY2026 first guide on 2025-12-17/18 drew -1.93% and -2.18% on the two sessions after it (Yahoo tape).
findings.original_quote: Zarząd Grupy Kęty S.A. informuje, iż w trakcie procesu przygotowania raportu okresowego za trzeci kwartał 2023 roku, którego elementem jest weryfikacja opublikowanych prognoz rocznych, powziął informację o wyższych, niż poprzednio zakładano szacunkach. (The Management Board reports that while preparing the Q3 2023 periodic report, which includes verifying the published annual forecasts, it learned of higher estimates than previously assumed.)
findings.why_not_priced: Seven analysts can do the 9M arithmetic, so the run-rate is probably priced; consensus is presumably above the guide. What is not priced is whether management formally lifts the guide or explicitly flags Q4 weakness to defend it. If a raise were priced, the stock would sit above Trigon's 1,325 PLN target rather than at 1,244, ~6% below its 1,317 high.
findings.independence: Q4 2025 base from the issuer's own Q4 2025 estimate (https://grupakety.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Szacunkiza4kw.irok2025zalacznikdoraportu.pdf); the 2021 precedent is a separate document (https://grupakety.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/202110aktualizacjaprognozy.pdf)

findings.finding: The Q3 estimate itself flags a demand correction: a holiday lull, customers waiting for lower raw-material prices, and utilisation down to 85-88% from >90% in Q2. LME aluminium has slipped to ~3,110 USD/t in early October from a 3,223 Q3 average, so the 27 Oct conference's Q4 commentary is more likely cautious than upbeat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell -1.49% on 25 Sep, the session after this commentary came out with the Q3 estimate (Yahoo tape), so it was partly digested.
findings.original_quote: Po bardzo dynamicznym początku kwartału na rynku widoczna była korekta popytu spowodowana okresem wakacyjnym oraz wyczekiwaniem na obniżki notowań surowców. Poziom wykorzystania mocy produkcyjnych jest nadal wysoki i wynosi ok 85 – 88% w zależności od Segmentu. (After a very dynamic start to the quarter, a demand correction was visible, caused by the holiday period and by waiting for lower raw-material prices. Capacity utilisation is still high at about 85-88% depending on the segment.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: it has been public for a month. The open question is whether the correction ran into October. Aluminium price transmission to Kęty's margins is a macro-to-company hypothesis, so the finding is kept small.

findings.finding: Final reported numbers have recently come in slightly above the company's own estimates: Q2 2026 net 241m and EBITDA 379m against estimates of 234m and 375m. Q3 2025 was mixed, with net 176m against 173m but EBITDA 294m against 297m. A small upside revision to the 201m Q3 estimate is mildly more likely than a downside one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Days after QSr releases (all amc): 2026-04-23 +0.71%, 2026-07-30 -2.82% (Yahoo tape). The final-versus-estimate gap has not visibly driven the stock.

findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the quarter was pre-released and a 1-2% revision to a pre-release is immaterial on a 13bn PLN name. Kept near zero per the pre-release rule.

findings.finding: The +55m PLN q/q rise in Q3 net debt (to ~1,180m) is roughly accounted for by the first dividend tranche of 16.33 PLN/share paid on 3 Sep, about 161m PLN on ~9.86m shares. Underlying Q3 cash generation therefore looks positive, and the Q3 cash-flow statement is unlikely to show a working-capital build.
findings.original_quote: Szacowany dług netto na koniec 3 kwartału 2026 r. wyniesie ok. 1 180 mln PLN, co oznacza poziom porównywalny z końcem 3 kwartału 2025 r. i o ok. 55 mln PLN wyższy od końca kwartału poprzedniego. (Estimated net debt at the end of Q3 2026 will be about 1,180m PLN, comparable with the end of Q3 2025 and about 55m PLN higher than at the end of the previous quarter.)
